_meta.purpose: Maps agent_type → bundle formula. Read by 7x_spawn_template.py at render time when --bundle-formula is invoked. Conservative is the safe default; experimental is capability-gated.
_meta.decision_rule: If agent_type is in experimental_agents AND formula arg is 'experimental', use experimental. Otherwise always use conservative. Integrity-critical types are LOCKED to conservative regardless of caller arg.
_meta.general_purpose_policy: agent_type='general-purpose' is DEPRECATED as a direct spawn target. Route unclassifiable tasks to 'stigmergy-scout' via prompt-injection (mth00091). The string 'general-purpose' is retained in route_task_by_content() as a fallback SIGNAL only — 7x_spawn_template.py rejects any Agent() spawn with agent_type=general-purpose unless (a) the prompt carries scout-protocol prefix or (b) task_type is in {general, unknown, misc}. Enforcement also in 8x_spawn_contract_enforcer.py (SCOUT_PROTOCOL_ENFORCE env).

integrity_locked_conservative.description: These agent types are ALWAYS conservative — experimental formula is refused even if caller passes --bundle-formula experimental. Integrity-critical: forensic chain, evidence handling, COC management.

agents.name: coc-manager
agents.note: proxy_type updated from general-purpose to stigmergy-scout per mth00091

integrity_locked_conservative.rationale: Forensic integrity + chain-of-custody require deterministic, minimal context injection. Experimental NECTAR tail-50 + droplet injection introduces ambient context drift risk near evidence writes.

experimental_agents.description: These agent types may use experimental formula when --bundle-formula experimental is passed. Capability-gated: high-synthesis, exploration, architecture roles benefit from richer context.
experimental_agents.rationale: Synthesis and exploration tasks benefit from NECTAR tail-50 + scoped HONEY + top-5 droplets. Richer context improves connection-making without threatening forensic integrity.

conservative_agents.description: These agent types default to conservative regardless of formula arg (but are NOT locked — experimental may be forced via --force-formula flag if needed for testing).

agents.name: stigmergy-scout
agents.note: Canonical replacement for general-purpose fallback (mth00091). Use prompt-injection to activate scout behavioral protocol.

conservative_agents.rationale: Coordination and ETL agents rarely benefit from expanded NECTAR context. Conservative keeps spawn overhead minimal.

conservative.description: Minimal context: HONEY tail-30, NECTAR tail-30, pollen excerpt. No droplets. ~4K tokens.

experimental.description: Rich context: scoped HONEY, NECTAR tail-50 tag-filtered, pollen+2 siblings, top-5 droplets. ~9.7K tokens.
